LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_II.label: quasaric analyzer
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_II.description: Build a quasaric analyzer, which simulates the quasi-stellar object at the center of your galaxy to aid research and unlock kwazaari-tier research projects. The Kwazaari will enjoy their monopoly no longer.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_II.discoveredLette: You are now able to inefficiently forge Quasar Alloy. Recipes for it can be found at the Sunsteel Shaper.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_II.label: accretic condenser
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_II.description: Produce kwazaari alloy from sunsteel, gold, and uranium at a sunsteel shaper. Build the neutronium refabricator and theta forge to craft kwazaari alloy products. Craft Kwazaari universal parts, uniquely-tooled components for most kwazaari buildings.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_II.label: kwazaari energy
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_II.description: Generate power in amounts fit to compete with the Kwazaari Corporation themselves. Build a neutronium reactor to exploit the unique interaction between dissoluted neutronium and the permittivity of kwazaari alloy.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_II.label: kwazaari battery
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_II.description: Build stronger batteries from kwazaari alloy to hold ever-greater amounts of power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_II.label: kwazaari armor
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_II.description: Manufacture power armor typical of Kwazaari private military contractors.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_II.label: kwazaari weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_II.description: Craft kwazaari weapons that utilize the superior properties of kwazaari alloy to secure greater profits at any cost
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussWeaponry.label: kwazaari gauss weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussWeaponry.description: Develop advanced gauss weapons that evolve earlier solarite prototypes into full-production kwazaari systems, accelerating kwazaari alloy projectiles at extreme velocity.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussSpecialistWeaponry.label: kwazaari gauss specialist weapons
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussSpecialistWeaponry.descri: Refine specialist kwazaari gauss variants for precision marksman and close-assault roles beyond the capabilities of first-generation solarite platforms.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussHighCaliberWeaponry.label: kwazaari gauss heavy weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussHighCaliberWeaponry.descr: Engineer heavy kwazaari gauss systems that upscale proven prototype architectures into sustained high-caliber anti-armor and suppressive platforms.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamWeaponry.label: kwazaari beam weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamWeaponry.description: Advance beam weapon engineering from solarite prototype emitters into robust kwazaari-grade plasma-beam systems optimized for high-energy combat roles.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamSpecialistWeaponry.label: kwazaari beam specialist weapons
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamSpecialistWeaponry.descrip: Develop specialist kwazaari beam variants for precision and close-quarters combat, refining lessons learned from earlier solarite specialist prototypes.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamHeavyWeaponry.label: kwazaari beam heavy weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamHeavyWeaponry.description: Scale beam technology into heavy kwazaari platforms delivering sustained suppressive output and long-range precision from matured prototype concepts.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_II.label: kwazaari medicine production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_II.description: Produce medical items common to Kwazaari Quiklinic-brand private healthcare facilities.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_II.label: kwazaari bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_II.description: Build Kwazaari body parts to replace missing appendages and organs or supplant natural flesh. Requires picoclusters and a skilled doctor to attach.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_II.label: kwazaari drug production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_II.description:
Produce drugs found among Kwazaari employees and corpo-slaves alike.
Castra is a powerful disease prevention drug that blocks many common ailments - including infection - before they are contracted, more so than Aegis.
Sunlight is a euphoria-inducing drink refined from sunweave. While it reduces the need for rest and suppresses pain, it is addictive, albeit less so than sunlite.
Canter is a synthetic combat drug used by Solarite militaries to improve shooting, melee, and movement while dulling pain in the user.
Sleepquitin is a productivity-enhancement drug which almost removes the users need to sleep.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_II.label: kwazaari recreation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_II.description: Build recreational facilities comparable to those of Kwazaari C-suite executives. Lucky!
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_II.label: kwazaari hydroponics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_II.description: Build the superior hydroponics system from kwazaari alloy.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_II.label: standard n-synthesis
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_II.description: Build the refinery, which uses kwazaari alloy and Kwazaari universal parts to lose less neutronium during the synthesis stage, granting you much more efficient neutronosynthesis recipes.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_III.label: galactic analyzer
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_III.description: Build a dark mirror, an extreme astronomical device that scrutinizes interstellar space for insights into dark matter. The dark mirror greatly aids your research and unlocks Tenebral research projects. In emulating Tenebral society you may, one day, join them.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_III.discoveredLett: You are now able to inefficiently form tenebrite crystals. Recipes for it can be found at the neutronium refabricator.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_III.label: gravitic crystal shaping
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_III.description: Produce tenebrite, a crystalline material derived from kwazaari alloy and stray dark matter. Craft crystalline joints from tenebrite, crucial components in tenebrite products. Build tenebrite structures and craft tenebrite tools and weapons; they will be supreme to nearly all others.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_III.label: tenebrite energy
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_III.description: Build the dark reactor, which captures energy from stray, non-interacting particles to freely generate power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_III.label: tenebrite battery
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_III.description: Build tenebral batteries to store supreme amounts of power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_III.label: tenebrite armor
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_III.description: Fabricate tenebral power armor, a shadowy suit of armor to set your footing equal to Tenebral communes.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_III.label: tenebrite weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_III.description: Craft weapons of Mass Destruction and Mass-Destruction utilizing your new Tenebrite materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_III.label: tenebrite medicine production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_III.description: Produce dark medicine, the tenebral medical fabricator, and femtoclusters: small machines that give your doctors agency in small places, needed for tenebral medical procedures.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_III.label: tenebrite bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_III.description: Build tenebral body parts to supersede natural flesh. Requires femtoclusters and a skilled doctor to attach.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_III.label: tenebrite drug production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_III.description:
Produce drugs commonly enjoyed in tenebral space communes.
Pax is a powerful disease prevention drug that blocks virtually all ailments - including infection and neurodegenerative disorders like dementia.
Crewmates are euphoria-inducing gummy candies refined from sunweave. While they reduce the need for rest and suppress pain, they are addictive, albeit less so than sunlight. Note: keep away from children!
Gallop is a synthetic combat psychedelic/steroid used by tenebral offensive units to improve shooting, melee, and movement while all-but-negating pain in the user... sometimes also used recreationally by the affluent within Tenebral Society.
Adreamoline is a productivity-enhancement drug which negates the user's need to sleep.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_III.label: tenebrite recreation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_III.description: Build recreational facilities you might find in Tenebral apartments. They frequently go unused in their namesake's abode; perhaps you can make better use of them.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_III.label: tenebrite hydroponics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_III.description: Build the superior hydroponics system from tenebrite crystals.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_III.label: high n-synthesis
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_III.description: Build the refinery, which uses kwazaari alloy and Kwazaari universal parts to lose less neutronium during the synthesis stage, granting you much more efficient neutronosynthesis recipes.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_IV.label: laborless neutronium brew
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_IV.description: Construct the umbral neutronium self-sustained generator, which turns energy into neutronium and other materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Gate_IV.label: ultimate research gate
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Gate_IV.description: All of your technological efforts so far have been toward recreating preestablished human tech. But now, you have reached the end of rediscovery. Now is the opportunity for something yours - something new. What was once beyond your reach is now yours for the taking.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_IV.label: unlimited power
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_IV.description: Construct the umbral reactor, a source of free energy (as far as you're concerned).
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_IV.label: unlimited production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_IV.description: Construct the umbral creation engine, which turns energy into neutronium and other materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_IV.label: umbral bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutProc_IV.label: self-sustaining production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutProc_IV.description: Construct the umbral forge, which turns energy into neutronium and other materials.
